# Core — Deep Context

## src/ws-constants.ts  ← NEW

Single source of truth for WS close codes and reason strings. Both server (`websocket.ts`) and `take-control-logic.ts` import from here — no string literals in either.

### Close codes
- `CLOSE_CODE_NORMAL = 1000`
- `CLOSE_CODE_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE = 4001`
- `CLOSE_CODE_DISPLACED = 4002`

### WS_CLOSE_REASONS (const object)
`PTY_EXITED`, `SESSION_UNAVAILABLE`, `DISPLACED`, `PTY_TEARDOWN`, `SESSION_ENDED`

**INVARIANT**: `ws-constants.ts` is THE protocol contract for close codes. All close-code checks anywhere in the codebase MUST use these constants — never magic numbers or inline strings.

## src/grid-logic.ts

### gridLayoutClass(count)
Maps 2-6 to "grid-N", all others to "grid-2". No runtime guard for count=0/1.

### isGridActive(sessions)
True when >= 2 sessions. Threshold hardcoded.

### addToGridState(gridSessions, session, machine, currentSession, currentMachine)
Returns new session list + focusIndex, or null on rejection.
- Capacity gate: MAX_GRID_CELLS=6
- Dedup: both session AND machine must match
- Bootstrap: when transitioning from empty, auto-prepends current session (ensuring >= 2)
- focusIndex always points to last element

### removeFromGridState(gridSessions, idx, focusIndex)
Focus adjustment: if removing before focus, shift left. If removing at/after focus, clamp. Collapses to empty array when <= 1 remains. restoreSession set when exactly 1 survives.

### suspendGridState/resumeGridState
Deep-copy sessions array + clamp focusIndex. Returns focusedSession as reference into cloned array. Both delegate to private `cloneGridState`.

### gridTemplate(count)
CSS grid template strings. Count 5 uses `repeat(6, 1fr)` — requires CSS spanning rule. Must stay in sync with gridArrowNav cols and CSS.

### gridArrowNav(direction, currentIndex, cellCount)
Layout-aware keyboard nav. cols derived from cellCount via static switch. Returns unchanged index on out-of-bounds.

### canAcceptInput/canSendResize/computeInputGate
Input gating predicates. canAcceptInput requires hasController + isConnected + isFocused. canSendResize drops focus requirement. computeInputGate hardcodes hasController:true (unchecked precondition). `canAcceptInputDefault` is the single-terminal (non-grid) path.

## src/take-control-logic.ts

### State Machine
Per grid cell: `{displaced: boolean, autoTakeControl: boolean}`. Four possible states. autoTakeControl is one-shot.

Transitions:
- `handleViewerConflict`: armed -> auto-take-control + disarm; not armed -> show-overlay (returns spread copy in both branches — no mutation)
- `handleControlGranted`: resets both flags to false
- `classifyDisconnect`: uses constants from ws-constants.ts (4002->displaced, 4001->session-ended, 1000+"pty exited"->pty-exited, else->reconnect)
- `handleTakeControlClick`: connected->send-take-control, disconnected->reconnect-with-auto
- `handleDisplaced`: sets displaced=true
- `prepareAutoTakeControl`: sets autoTakeControl=true

### Re-exports
Re-exports `CLOSE_CODE_DISPLACED`, `CLOSE_CODE_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE`, `CLOSE_CODE_NORMAL`, `WS_CLOSE_REASONS` so existing consumers don't need to update imports.

**INVARIANT**: `classifyDisconnect` depends on the exact string `WS_CLOSE_REASONS.PTY_EXITED = "pty exited"` from server. Now compile-time enforced via ws-constants import (previously a raw string — fixed).

## src/terminal-buffer.ts

### captureScrollState(buffer)
Snapshots scroll position: wasAtBottom and distanceFromBottom. Both are redundant (wasAtBottom === distanceFromBottom===0).

### scrollTargetAfterResize(nextBaseY, distanceFromBottom)
`Math.max(0, nextBaseY - distanceFromBottom)`.

### serializeBufferTail(buffer, maxLines)
Last N lines as newline-joined string. Null lines silently dropped. No output length cap.

## src/terminal-input.ts

### shouldInterceptCopy(event, hasSelection)
Intercepts Cmd/Ctrl+C with selection (copy) vs pass-through (SIGINT). On non-Mac, Ctrl+C with selection is intercepted — may prevent SIGINT.

### encodeTerminalBinary(data)
String to Uint8Array via `charCode & 0xff`. For xterm.js onBinary callback.

## src/reconnect-hydration.ts

### shouldRehydrate(wasReconnect, hydrationStarted, prefillDisabled)
`wasReconnect || (hydrationStarted && !prefillDisabled)`. Grid cells (prefillDisabled=true) skip rehydration on manual retry.

## src/triage.ts

### TriageStatus
Binary: `"running" | "idle"`. Simplified from earlier multi-state enum.

### JUNK_LINE_PATTERNS (5 regexes)
Box-drawing chars, Claude Code hint bars (`⏵⏵ accept edits`, `esc to interrupt`), bare prompts (`$%#>❯›»`), whitespace-only.

### isJunkLine(line)
Line-level predicate. Assumes VT escape sequences already stripped by caller.

**NOTE**: `INPUT_PATTERNS` and `isInputPrompt` removed in the triage simplification. Only junk-line detection remains. Callers that used `isInputPrompt` must have been updated or removed.

## src/validation.ts

**INVARIANT**: This is the ONLY trust boundary for untrusted input (session names, project names, plan files, branch names, commands). All server routes MUST validate through these functions before use in shell/tmux commands.

### WS_ALLOWED_KEYS (28-entry Set)
Classic terminal key allowlist. Includes "y"/"n" for yes/no buttons. Uses tmux notation (C-a, C-b). Missing: F1-F12, Insert.

### Regex validators
- `isValidProjectName`: `^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$`, rejects "." and "..". No length limit. Permits `...`.
- `isValidSessionName`: `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$`, max 100 chars. No dots.
- `isValidPlanFile`: `^[a-zA-Z0-9._\- ]+\.md$`, rejects "." and ".." (defensive; these can never match `.md` suffix anyway).
- `CMD_REGEX`: `^[a-zA-Z0-9 \-._/=]+$` — permits slashes (path-based commands like `./my-script`).
- `BRANCH_REGEX`: `^(?!.*\.\.)(?!.*\/\/)[a-zA-Z0-9._\-/]+$`
- `SAFE_FILENAME`: `^[a-zA-Z0-9._\- ]+$` — new, used for filename checks without `.md` requirement.

### shellEscape(s)
POSIX single-quote wrapping with `'\''` for embedded quotes. NUL bytes now stripped (`.replace(/\0/g, "")`) before wrapping — previously passed through unescaped.

### clampCols/clampRows
clampCols: [20, 300], default 80. clampRows: [5, 100], default 24. Handle NaN/Infinity via Number.isFinite.

### expandBudget(current, subtaskCount, ceiling)
`Math.min(current + Math.max(0, subtaskCount), ceiling)` — now guards against negative subtaskCount (previously unguarded). Short-circuits when already at ceiling.

### buildSrtSettings(allowedWriteDir)
Builds sandbox settings for ralph agent sessions. Resolves ripgrep binary (prefers PATH `rg`, falls back to claude's bundled multicall binary). Allowlist includes major package registries + Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini APIs.

### xmlEsc/systemdEsc
xmlEsc: escapes &, <, >, ", ' (& first to avoid double-escaping). systemdEsc: escapes \, ", strips newlines.

## src/wolfpack-context.ts

### TASK_HEADER regex
`^#{2,3} (?:~~)?(?:\w+ )?\d+[a-z]?[\.\):]\s+` — matches plan section headers like `## 1. Title`, `### Phase 2: Title`, `## ~~3. Done~~`.

### countTasksInContent
Format-aware: if TASK_HEADER matches exist, counts only headers (done = lines with `~~`). Falls back to checkbox count otherwise. **No longer double-counts** mixed-format plans — headers take priority.

### validatePlanFormat
Flags ambiguous headers (match AMBIGUOUS_HEADERS but not TASK_HEADER). Requires at least one parseable task.

### detectOldPlanFormat
Returns true if OLD_TASK_PATTERN (`Task N: Title`) found and no TASK_HEADER present. Gating function before migratePlanFormat.

### migratePlanFormat
Rewrites old `Task N: Title` to `## N. Title`. Uses `gim` regex flags (multiline mode critical for `^` matching).

### RALPH_AGENT_CONTEXT / INTERACTIVE_CONTEXT
Two focused context strings replacing old monolithic WOLFPACK_CONTEXT. Ralph context: subtask output protocol. Interactive context: plan format conventions.

## src/worktree.ts

### createWorktree(projectDir, branchName, baseBranch)
Creates git worktree at `.wolfpack/worktrees/<slug>`. realpathSync on projectDir. Records path in order file. Throws if git worktree add fails; order-file write failure is non-fatal (warn only).

### removeWorktree(worktreePath, projectDir?)
Graceful then `--force` removal. Force discards uncommitted changes. Now throws on both failures (previously may have swallowed the force error).

### parsePorcelainWorktrees(output)
Exported for testing. Handles final section without trailing newline (fixed — previously may have missed it).

### cleanupAllExceptFinal(projectDir)
Keeps last worktree by creation order file, falls back to numeric path sort. `_cleanupInProgress` flag prevents re-entrant cleanup. After cleanup: prunes stale refs and rewrites order file to contain only the kept path.
- No mutex — concurrent calls from separate processes will both read/write the order file without coordination.
- Unrecorded (manually-created) worktrees sort after all recorded ones.

### slugifyTaskName(header)
Lowercase, kebab-case, max 40 chars. Does not guarantee uniqueness.

## src/log.ts

### createLogger(component)
Factory returning `{debug, info, warn, error}`. JSON structured logs. error->stderr, others->stdout.

### currentLevel()
Reads WOLFPACK_LOG_LEVEL env per call (not cached). Overhead per log call, but allows runtime level changes.

### emit(level, component, msg, extra?)
Filters extra keys against RESERVED_KEYS set before spread — reserved fields (ts, level, component, msg) can no longer be overwritten by callers (ISS-13 fixed).

### errMsg
Re-exported from `./shared/process-cleanup.js`. Convenience for extracting message from unknown catch values.

## Cross-module coupling

- `take-control-logic.ts` imports `ws-constants.ts` (close codes + reasons)
- `worktree.ts` imports `log.ts` (createLogger, errMsg)
- `validation.ts` imports node:path, node:child_process, node:fs, node:os (NOT pure — has I/O in buildSrtSettings/resolveRipgrepBin)
- `wolfpack-context.ts` is pure (no imports beyond stdlib patterns)
- All other core modules are pure functions with no imports

## Known issues / smells

- `validation.ts` L109-118: `resolveRipgrepBin` uses `execFileSync("which", ...)` at runtime — synchronous subprocess per call. Should be cached at module load or called once.
- `grid-logic.ts` L14: `gridLayoutClass` returns "grid-2" for count=0/1 — callers assume count >= 2 before calling; no enforcement.
- `triage.ts`: `isJunkLine` assumes caller stripped VT escapes. No assertion or stripping in the function itself — silent wrong results if raw terminal output passed.
- `validation.ts` L103: `isValidPlanFile` redundant "." and ".." rejection (these cannot match the `.md` suffix pattern).
- `worktree.ts` L14: `_cleanupInProgress` is module-level — only prevents re-entrancy within the same process, not across concurrent processes.
- `log.ts` L20: `currentLevel()` is called on every log line — re-reads env var each time. Fine for correctness, minor overhead.
- `terminal-buffer.ts` L57: `captureScrollState` returns both `wasAtBottom` and `distanceFromBottom` but they're derivable from each other — redundant fields.
